_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for what differs between the three test pages. Everything else (copy, structure, scripts) comes from src/page.html and is identical. Per page: hero image, palette/look file (theme), font set and hero background effect. Edit this file, then run: node build.mjs
_robotsNote: TEST ONLY: all three pages are noindex,nofollow during the Meta ads A/B test. To put / back in search results after the test, set variants[0].robots to "index, follow" and re-run node build.mjs.
